slot.brief: Select a committee of a given size from men and women with a minimum/maximum gender constraint; count cases by composition.

stem: A committee of $8$ is chosen from $10$ men and $8$ women. How many committees have at least $3$ and at most $5$ women?
solution:
For $w$ women, the remaining $8-w$ members are men. Hence,
$$\sum_{w=3}^{5}\binom{8}{w}\binom{10}{8-w}=\binom{8}{3}\binom{10}{5}+\binom{8}{4}\binom{10}{4}+\binom{8}{5}\binom{10}{3}=14,112+14,700+6,720=35,532.$$
